subject: general
question: In which year Guru Gobind Singh died?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1708**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Guru Gobind Singh**, the tenth Sikh Guru, passed away on **7 October 1708** at **Nanded, Maharashtra**.
 
• He was the last of the Sikh Gurus and played a pivotal role in shaping the Sikh religion and community.
 
• Guru Gobind Singh's death marked the end of the line of human Gurus in Sikhism. He declared the **Guru Granth Sahib** as the eternal Guru of Sikhs before his passing.
 
• He was assassinated by a Pathan named Jamshed Khan, who was sent by the Mughal Governor of Sirhind, Wazir Khan, as part of a conspiracy.
 
• Guru Gobind Singh's leadership and sacrifices were instrumental in establishing the Khalsa Panth, a community of initiated Sikhs who uphold justice and equality.
